text:
morgan: Quick snap poll: two tiny questions, pick with emoji.

1) Best editor  react :vscode: for VS Code, :neovim: for Neovim, :intellij: for IntelliJ, :emacs: for Emacs.
2) Favorite model codename for swag? react :alpha: for "Falcon", :beta: for "Cedar", :gamma: for "Bonsai", :delta: for "Nimbus".

pollbot: Poll started by morgan.

devon: :vscode: + :beta: (Cedar tee pls)

rachel: :neovim: + :gamma: (Bonsai sticker ftw)

oscar: :intellij: + :delta: (Nimbus sounds like a hoodie)

morgan: :vscode: + :beta: myself, but i like all the names tbh

pollbot: Current tallies: VS Code 2, Neovim 1, IntelliJ 1; Cedar 2, Bonsai 1, Nimbus 1, Falcon 0

rachel: Lunch question too  pizza (:pizza:) or salad (:green_salad:)?

devon: :pizza: definitely

oscar: :green_salad: trying to be healthy

morgan: :pizza: will win, i'm calling it. ordering at 12:10. anyone want gluten free?

rachel: gluten-free pizza for me pls

pollbot: Poll closed. Final: VS Code wins editor, Cedar wins model-name swag, pizza ordered (1 GF).

morgan: thanks all! swag idea noted — cedar tees when we do the next giveaway :tada:
